title: Reading the Appraisal Register for the Figure a Revaluation Share Is Taken On
content:
Under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes the share used in a revaluation is taken on the price the piece originally sold for, except in two situations that turn on the report the registration names in the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services register and on the registration's own valuation entries.

## The rule

- Where the report the registration names was issued within the programme's appraisal validity window and the appraisal register carries a value for the traded piece above the price it originally sold for, the share is taken on the highest value the appraisal register carries for that piece.
- Where the report the registration names was issued longer ago than the validity window and the registration's own entries carry a valuation of the piece, the share is taken on the highest valuation the registration's own entries carry.
- Otherwise the share is taken on the price the piece originally sold for.

The report the registration names is the appraisal recorded against the registration; its age is counted in calendar days from the date the report was signed to the handling date, and it is within the window while that count does not exceed the window. A value the register carries for the piece is a valuation recorded against that piece in the appraisal register; where several are recorded, the highest is taken. A valuation among the registration's own entries is a valuation entry recorded against the registration.

## The validity window by programme

| Programme | Appraisal validity window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 180 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 365 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 180 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 180 |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

A piece originally sold for 9000 USD under a programme with a 365-day window.

- The named report was signed 200 days ago and the register carries values of 9500 and 10200 USD for the piece: the share is taken on 10200 USD.
- The named report was signed 200 days ago and the register carries only 8800 USD for the piece, which is not above 9000: the share is taken on 9000 USD.
- The named report was signed 400 days ago and the registration's own entries carry valuations of 9100 and 9400 USD: the share is taken on 9400 USD.
- The named report was signed 400 days ago and the registration's own entries carry no valuation: the share is taken on 9000 USD.
